TAB 1 · AUTOPILOT (home)
The view you picked — the game→profile list, front and center, with the master On/Off.

TAB 2 · MOUSE SETUP  ← new
The second segment of the top switcher. Pick which profile you're editing (top-left), then Buttons / Lighting / Sensitivity. Click a thumb button on the map to change what it does in the panel on the right. One "Apply" writes it to the mouse.
The two directions you didn't pick, kept here for reference.
